standard.summary: 训练时用负面提示词做 LoRA-on / LoRA-off 差异约束
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Uses negative prompts during training as a LoRA-on / LoRA-off difference constraint
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练时用负面提示词做 LoRA-on / LoRA-off 差异约束，压制靠近负面语义的 LoRA 增量。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: During training, applies a LoRA-on / LoRA-off difference constraint with the negative prompt, suppressing LoRA increments close to the negative semantics. Off by default.
